info.name: Kubernetes Services Kubernetes Network Policies API

description.content:
The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy API controls how groups of Pods communicate with each other and with external network endpoints. Policies define ingress and egress rules based on Pod selectors, namespace selectors, and IP blocks, allowing cluster operators to implement fine-grained network segmentation and zero-trust networking within a Kubernetes cluster.
